title: Strip each line before printing
description: You remove surrounding whitespace from file lines before adding numbered labels.

steps.description: You open the grocery file and initialize count. The loop receives each line as a string.
You replace line with line.strip(), removing whitespace from its ends. The print then combines that cleaned text with the number.

steps.question: Does the counter increment happen before or after the cleaned line is printed?
steps.answer: It happens afterward. The printed label uses the current counter value.

steps.description: You update count and close the file after reading. The recording shows the grocery lines consecutively, without the earlier blank lines between them.
